sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Forgetful, ill-humored, gloomy during
stormy weather.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Pulsating forehead ; better, pressure and in
warm room. Shocks through head.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Burning of eyes with aversion to light. Eye-
strain. mur.]

sections.label: Ears
sections.text:
Hardness of hearing. Shocks through ears,
eyes, and nose, when gnashing teeth.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Discharge of sharp, burning water Stop-
page at night, ivith long-continued coryza. Cannot
breathe through nose. Snuffles of children. Epistaxis
after washing and after eating. Ozaena, blows bloody
mucus from nose. Tip of nose congested.

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Tetters around mouth. Boils and pustules,
during menses. Corners of mouth sore, cracked, and
burn.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Great dryness of mouth and throat. Tooth-
ache. Pressing teeth together sends shocks through
head, eyes, and ears. Vesicles on tongue. Taste sour;
metallic. Cracking of jaw on chewing.

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Enlarged tonsils and glands of neck. Burn-
ing pain all down throat. Tendency to gangrenous ul-
ceration of tonsils. Diphtheria when nose is stopped up.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Pain at pit of stomach, with heartburn,
nausea, waterbrash, and chilliness. Great appetite, but
easily satisfied.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Noise and pain in abdomen. Flatulent
hernia. Stools difficult, hard, and knotty. Bleeding
piles; worse during menses. Itching at anus. Pro-
truding piles, worse after stool, better lying down.

48

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Frequent desire; involuntary at night.
Tenesmus of bladder. Urine white, sandy, bloody,
copious, turbid, and fetid.

sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Itching and pain of scrotum and spermatic
cords. Erection without desire. Seminal emissions.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Itching, swelling and burning of puden-
dum. Leucorrhoea burning, acrid, watery. Aversion to
the other sex. Menses too frequent, profuse, early,
copious, clotted, black; colicky pains, and hard, difficult
stool, with fatigue, especially of thighs; yawning and
chilliness.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Horseness. Cough every morning
about three o’clock, with dyspnoea, palpitation, burn-
ing in chest; worse ascending. Chest feels tired. Em-
physema. Mucfi oppression in breathing; worse after
any effort, and entering warm room, or ascending even
a few steps. Slow labored, stertorous breathing; bub-
bling sound. Winter catarrh, . with slimy sputum and
specks of blood.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text:
Audible palpitation with fear, cold sweat,
lachrymation, inability to speak, loud breathing and
trembling hands. Heart weak, wakes with difficult
breathing and palpitation.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Tearing in joints relieved by heat of
bed ; inclination to stretch limbs. Hands cold and blue ;
distended veins. Fingers swell when arm is hanging
down. Panaritium, dep-seated periosteal pain. Cramps
calves and soles. Big toe painful and swollen.
^Felons in the beginning. Heel painful on standing.

in ankle and bones of feet, better when warm

— Sleepiness during the day. Starts from
Hfeep strangling.

AMMONIUM CABR. — AMMONIUM CAUSTICUM 49

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Violent itching and burning blisters. Scarlet
rash. Miliary rash. Malignant scarlatina. Faintly de-
veloped eruptions from defective vitality. Erysipelas
in the aged, with brain symptoms. Eczema in the
bends of extremities, between legs, about anus and
genitals.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, from cold, wet weather, wet
application.^, washing, and during 3 to 4 a. m., during
mense.s. Better, lying on painful side and on stomach ;
in dry weather.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Inimical to Lachesis.

Antidotes: Arnica; Camphor.

Compare: Rhus; Muriatic acid; Tartar emet.

Of use in poisoning b> charcoal fumes.
